text:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — Generation API (genqueue) errors rising in eu-central-1. Error rate ~12% 5xx over 5m. Bridge: #incident-1767123456. Please acknowledge.
Priya Patel: I'm oncall, taking this. Spinning up the bridge and looking at KV hit rates + model shard assignment.
Danny Liao: Danny (SRE) - standby. Priya, any immediate customer-facing outage right now?
Priya Patel: Partial degradation for some customers hitting /v1/generate in eu-central. Latency up (~300ms p95) and a 5xx spike. No confirmed data exposure so far. Drafting a short statuspage message for initial publish — posting in-thread for quick review.
Priya Patel: ```Initial status (draft):
We are investigating increased errors impacting the Generation API (eu-central-1) starting at 2026-03-17T14:05Z. Some requests to /v1/generate may fail or see elevated latency. Our teams are investigating and applying mitigations. We will provide updates every ~20 minutes. No customer content was exposed.```
Sam Ortega: Quick edits: add the exact start time (done), call out affected endpoint (/v1/generate), and include guidance for customers (retry with backoff; we are not recommending client-side failsafe changes). Also, avoid promising routing changes — say "temporary routing may occur for some requests" only if ops can confirm. Recommend legal review for the data statement.
Lex Park: Suggest using the phrase "partial degradation" rather than "increased errors" and explicitly say "no data loss or exfiltration observed" if legal signs off.
legal-bot: Legal suggestion: preferred wording — "No customer content was exfiltrated or exposed." Confirm ok to publish?
Priya Patel: Updated draft with legal language and start time: ```We are investigating a partial degradation of the Generation API in eu-central-1 that began at 2026-03-17T14:05Z. Some requests to /v1/generate may fail or experience elevated latency. Our engineers are applying mitigations (scaling, restarts, fallback routing). No customer content was exfiltrated or exposed. We will post updates approximately every 20 minutes.``` Please review.
Danny Liao: Approve from SRE. Add mitigation bullet list: "rolling restart of gen-pool nodes; scale gen-pool to 2x; enable fallback model pool routing for struggling shards."
Sam Ortega: Comms approved pending confirmation that fallback routing text is accurate. If ops confirms, I'll publish.
Priya Patel: Confirming fallback routing is enabled but only for a subset of requests as a temporary measure — added to copy. Publishing initial now.
ops-bot: Status page updated: Incident GEN-2026-03-17 marked Investigating at 2026-03-17T14:07:12Z. external_id=GEN-2026-03-17.
Sam Ortega: Posted initial update to https://status.redwood.com/incidents/GEN-2026-03-17 — will post next update in ~20m.
Priya Patel: 20-minute update: errors down to ~6%, latency improving after scale and restarts. Still monitoring; next update in 20m.
Lex Park: Draft resolve ready: "Service returned to normal operation. No customer data exposed. Postmortem to follow within 72 hours."
Priya Patel: Resolved — we rolled a fix for shard assignment regression and validated traffic stabilization. Resolved at 2026-03-17T14:55:42Z. Publishing resolve now.
ops-bot: Status page updated: Incident GEN-2026-03-17 marked Resolved at 2026-03-17T14:55:42Z.
Sam Ortega: Published customer follow-up note and filed postmortem ETA (72h). Will ping #postmortems when draft ready.
Danny Liao: Monitoring for residuals; will close bridge in 30m if metrics remain stable.
Priya Patel: Closing bridge once SLOs stable for 30m. Thanks everyone for quick reviews and legal sign-off. :thumbsup:
